description: FastAPI-based REST API module for managing classes in a student attendance management system. Implements CRUD operations secured with JWT authentication, defining data models and route handlers.

classes.name: ClassCreate
classes.description: Pydantic model for creating a new class, including name, optional section, and teacher ID.

classes.name: ClassUpdate
classes.description: Pydantic model for updating class attributes. All fields optional.

classes.name: ClassOut
classes.description: Pydantic model representing class data returned in API responses, using ORM attributes via Config.

methods.name: create_class(class_in: ClassCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: API endpoint to create a new class, requires JWT. Uses POST /, returns created class.

methods.name: list_classes(skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve list of classes, with pagination support.

methods.name: get_class(class_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve class details by ID.

methods.name: update_class(class_id: int, class_in: ClassUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: API endpoint to update details of an existing class.

methods.name: delete_class(class_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: API endpoint to delete a class by ID.
